name: vuesp.led-matrix
summary: 16x16 WS2812 LED matrix with effects, brightness control and a visual draw editor.
description:
## Vuesp LED Matrix

ESP8266 project for a 16x16 WS2812/NeoPixel matrix (256 pixels) connected to GPIO 14. The firmware includes fire, lighters, rainbow, twinkling stars and theater chase effects, global brightness control and a visual `/draw` editor in the web UI.

The current frame and effect settings are stored in LittleFS and restored after reboot. The standard Vuesp dashboard, GPIO, ScriptRunner and OTA features are included.
